title: Which Branch Owns the Boundary Point
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For the same piecewise function ($x+2$ for $x<0$, $x^{2}$ for $x\ge 0$), evaluate $f(0)$ and explain how the boundary input is assigned.

steps.title: Inspect the Inequalities at Zero
steps.explanation: The strict condition excludes $0$, while the non-strict condition includes it.
steps.why: Boundary points belong to whichever branch carries the equality sign.
steps.mathExpression: x<0 \text{ fails at } 0;\quad x\ge 0 \text{ holds at } 0

steps.title: Apply the Quadratic Branch
steps.why: The inequality tag decides the formula, so no averaging of the two branches is allowed.

steps.title: Check the Other Branch's Limit Value
steps.explanation: Approaching from the left the linear branch tends to $2$, but the function's actual value is set by the branch that claims $x=0$.
steps.why: Function values at a boundary are independent of nearby branch behavior.
